quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's status for the upcoming game
quotes.excerpt: He went through the full practice today, so we'll see how he comes out tomorrow.
quotes.quote: Luka Doncic is trending in that way. He went through the full practice today, so we'll see how he comes out tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says Luka Doncic is trending in the right direction after going through a full practice today. The team will monitor how he feels tomorrow.

structured.context: Head coach Jordan Ott provides an update on Luka Doncic's injury status following a full practice session.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Managing minutes for Booker, Beal, and Durant
quotes.excerpt: Their minutes almost depend on our depth. Are we healthy? Are we able to go a little deeper?
quotes.quote: Their minutes almost depend on our depth. Are we healthy? Are we able to go a little deeper into our bench? What's the margin in the fourth quarter? Some of that is based on our depth, but yeah, we'll start nine or ten guys right off the bat.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns plan to start nine or ten guys in their rotation, noting that minutes for Booker, Beal, and Durant will depend on team depth and health.

structured.context: Jordan Ott discusses the team's strategy for managing the minutes of their star players during the upcoming season.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's offensive emphasis on paint touches
quotes.excerpt: We know we need some type of thrust to the rim, whether that's the ball, a roller, a cutter.
quotes.quote: We've made an emphasis there, but we've also looked at the numbers and know that there's not a big gap one to 30. There is very little correlation between paint touches to offensive rating. But we know we need some type of thrust to the rim, whether that's the ball, a roller, a cutter. We know we need something to break down the defense by putting pressure on the rim.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says there is very little correlation between paint touches and offensive rating, though the team still emphasizes putting pressure on the rim to break down defenses.

structured.context: Jordan Ott explains the team's offensive philosophy regarding paint touches and rim pressure.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of a player's extension on team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: He's a connector on the court, he's a connector off the court.
quotes.quote: He's done such a great job of just in the 15 months that I've been around him. He's an incredible worker, about all the right things that you want in an NBA professional as a human and as a basketball player. And then he's a connector. So he's a connector on the court, he's a connector off the court. Guys respect him for who he is as a person and as a player.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott praised a player for his impact on team chemistry, calling him a connector on and off the court who is respected by his teammates.

structured.context: Jordan Ott praises a player's character and impact on team chemistry following the player's recent contract extension.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: The team's culture and habits on the court
quotes.excerpt: The way you approach your job is to try to go all out all the time.
quotes.quote: I think it's stuff that you see in a game on the court and it's stuff that you don't see and you see here every day. The way you approach your job is to try to go all out all the time. And this group does that. This group does it in the weight room, it does it on the floor, and it does it together in an incredibly competitive environment and we do it consistently.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns group approaches their work with consistent effort in the weight room and on the floor.

structured.context: Jordan Ott describes the daily work habits and competitive culture established within the team.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Expectations for a new player's integration
quotes.excerpt: He's almost an experienced young guy at this point. He has NBA experience.
quotes.quote: He's another one of those connectors. His skill level, he's almost an experienced young guy at this point. He has NBA experience. Another person that will play both with us and with the Valley, help connect that group. It'll help connect us. He plays the right way, he's accomplished a lot in his college career and just another guy we want to get in our building.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says a new player will help connect the Suns and their G League affiliate, noting the player has the experience and skill level to play the right way.

structured.context: Jordan Ott discusses the integration of a new player into the team and his role in connecting the roster.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: The discrepancy between paint touches and offensive analytics
quotes.excerpt: Elite shooting teams don't necessarily need to touch the paint.
quotes.quote: Some teams can get high quality shots and just number of paint touches, they may only need one paint touch, not multiple in a possession. That would be one. Elite shooting teams don't necessarily need to touch the paint. You can get the right outside the paint, still collapse the defense with a roller or some type of cut. It's something that's hard to wrap your head around because you want some type of paint pressure.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott explains that elite shooting teams do not necessarily need high paint touch numbers to be effective, as they can collapse defenses through other means.

structured.context: Jordan Ott elaborates on the analytical perspective regarding why paint touches do not always correlate with offensive efficiency.

quotes.speaker: Jordan Ott
quotes.summary_phrase: Adapting offensive movement based on defensive schemes
quotes.excerpt: We found times during the year it would change based on how the defense was guarding.
quotes.quote: We found times during the year it would change based on how the defense was guarding. So if they helped in a certain way, we would either go early to clear that space, or if they changed and adjusted defenses, we would get to a certain point on the court then move. The idea is to definitely move because that compromises the defense, but also the playmaker should know where his outlets are.
quotes.social_post: Jordan Ott says the Suns offensive movement is designed to compromise the defense, with playmakers needing to know their outlets based on how the opponent is guarding them.

structured.context: Jordan Ott explains how the team adjusts its offensive movement and playmaking based on opposing defensive schemes.
